summary: Register the host's native B12X checkpoint loader when available
models: Models selecting the B12X checkpoint loader plugin
compatibility: The b12x_loader plugin delegates to the native vLLM loader when its module is available. Hosts without that module retain the packaged adapter, and custom loader registration remains supported.
details: Errors importing an existing native loader propagate instead of selecting the packaged adapter. Native shared-GDS allocator handling therefore applies when launch scripts explicitly enable the plugin.
